QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Self-Determination
QuestInfo.0: Krania and those complicit in her schemes have fled, leaving the Aspire building empty.\r\nWhat should be done with the Wondroids left behind?\r\nGo and discuss this with #bSpencer#k.
QuestInfo.2: In the end, it was the Wondroids themselves who decided their own fates. Some opted to remain as they were, while others chose to have their memories erased.
QuestInfo.1: Use the #bBroken Scion Mainframe#k to wipe the memories of the remaining Wondroids.
